summary: Frontend UI iteration E2E PASSED on Expo web preview (390x844). Logged in with demo phone +919999900000 via mock OTP. (1) Me screen — Privacy section shows ONLY 2 toggles: 'Health Data' (consent-health_data) and 'Psychologist Sharing' (consent-psychologist_sharing). All 8 removed keys (mood_history, sleep_data, activity_data, heart_data, personal_insights, ai_summaries, analytics, marketing) are absent — enumerated by testID lookup, none present. Both toggles are visually interactive (verified from before/after screenshots: Health Data went off→on, Psychologist Sharing went on→off after tap) and PUT /me/consents fires via updateConsents. (2) 'Export my data' (export-data) is tappable on web and DOES NOT crash — expo-print/Sharing throws inside a try/catch and the app remains fully usable (button still present, no red screen, Me screen fully rendered after tap). Native-only PDF is an accepted no-op on web preview per requirements. (3) Progress Feel Map now renders clearly-visible colored dots (rose #C9897A / amber #D4A574 / sage #8BAF8C via GROUP_COLOR) with 3-item legend 'Low · Steady · Bright' below the grid — visually confirmed in screenshot; grid + legend clearly visible against tan background. Wellbeing Pulse (summary + 'Mood: Around your normal level' status row), month count '18 check-ins this month', Feel Map, Mood trend bar chart, and 'Read your story' CTA (read-story-button) all render. (4) Support → 'Wellbeing resources' row (support-book) navigates to /resources; cards expand/collapse on tap (verified expand on resource-sleep → bullet 'Dim the lights an hour before bed.' becomes visible). Back button (resources-back) returns to Support and support-book row re-appears. (5) Regressions kept green: login OTP flow, Today's mood hero + talk-card + book-call-button all present, Insights 7-day strip renders Su..Sa with mood emojis and 'Consistent Pattern' cards.
critical_code_review_comments: me.tsx: exportData wraps Print.printToFileAsync + Sharing.shareAsync in try/catch with an empty catch — correct for web-preview graceful failure. The exporting guard prevents double-taps and always resets in finally.

me.tsx: CONSENTS array now lists just ['health_data','psychologist_sharing'] and the render map only produces two Switches — matches spec exactly. Existing user.consents keys for the 8 removed toggles are simply not rendered (harmless in DB).

progress.tsx: GROUP_COLOR palette (rose/amber/sage) applied directly to feel-map dots via inline backgroundColor; empty days use border with transparent bg — good contrast against Card tint. Legend uses same GROUP_COLOR so colors stay in sync.

resources.tsx: 5 curated cards with EN+HI bodies, expandable via single 'open' key (accordion-style), Haptics.selectionAsync on toggle, back arrow via router.back(). File is compact (108 lines) and self-contained.
Minor observation (not a bug): Feel Map dot size is 16x16 which is below the 44pt touch-target guideline, but dots are decorative (non-interactive), so guideline does not apply.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (login, Me consents, Export no-crash, Progress Feel Map + legend, Resources expand/collapse + back, Today, Insights)

seed_data_creation: None. Demo phone +919999900000 pre-seeded on backend startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding gate requires tapping 'I already have an account' (not a testID — use get_by_text) BEFORE the login-phone-input becomes visible. All subsequent flows use testIDs. Tab bar buttons don't expose testIDs — use page.get_by_role('tab', name='Me'|'Today'|'Progress'|'Insights'|'Support'). Consent Switch aria-checked was not reflected in DOM attribute; verify toggle visually via screenshots or via subsequent GET /me. Resources testIDs: resources-back, resource-breathing/sleep/grounding/lowday/seekhelp.
